tactics:
induction l with
| nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
| cons a l ih =>
  intro acc
  simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, bind_pure_comp, map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases x with
  | none => simp [ih (acc := acc)]
  | some b => rw [ih (acc := b :: acc), ih (acc := [b])]; simp [Functor.map_map]
